_comment: Client-swappable brand + business layer for mobile event rental. SHIPS EMPTY. Fill on each deployment and every FAQ, email, SMS and workflow reflows. This is the layer the Skool/Scale Certified packs lack entirely - they hardcode business details into workflow content, so redeploying them means hand-editing every asset. Do NOT seed with one client's data.
_deployment_note: Values marked REQUIRED must be filled before any workflow is published - leaving them blank sends emails with holes in them. Values marked OPTIONAL degrade gracefully.

values.name: Booking Page URL
values._why: Every SMS and email CTA points here.

values.name: Logo URL
values._why: Funnel header/footer and thank-you page. Business-profile logo does not travel in snapshots, so it lives here explicitly.

values.name: Service Area List
values._why: Human-readable list used in FAQ and quote emails, e.g. 'Baton Rouge, New Orleans and the Northshore'.

values.name: Base Travel Radius Miles
values._why: Distance included before a travel fee applies. The AI is told to quote this number and nothing else about pricing.

values.name: Travel Fee Policy
values._why: One sentence, client's own words. Prevents the AI inventing a per-mile rate.

values.name: Rental Asset Name
values._why: What the thing IS - 'mobile golf simulator', '360 photo booth', 'mobile axe throwing trailer'. Used throughout copy so the template reads naturally for any single-asset operator.

values.name: Rental Asset Plural
values._why: For multi-unit operators.

values.name: Unit Count
values._why: How many physical units exist. This is the number that goes into the calendar equipment resource quantity and is what actually prevents double-booking.

values.name: Add-On Package Name
values._why: The upsell bundle, e.g. a game add-on package.

values.name: Pricing Page URL
values._why: The AI links here instead of quoting prices it cannot verify.

values.name: Deposit Percent
values._why: e.g. '50%'. Stated in the deposit request and every reminder.

values.name: Balance Due Days Before Event
values._why: Drives the balance reminder timing. e.g. '7'.

values.name: Payment Link
values._why: Stripe/invoice link. Deposit and balance emails are useless without it.

values.name: Cancellation Policy Summary
values._why: One paragraph in the client's own words. The AI quotes this verbatim and never paraphrases it.

values.name: Weather Policy Summary
values._why: The single most-asked question for outdoor events. Must be the client's actual policy, never the AI's guess.

values.name: Space Requirement Footprint
values._why: e.g. '15 ft x 20 ft'. The AI states this constantly - it is the top qualifying question.

values.name: Space Requirement Height
values._why: e.g. '12 ft ceiling clearance'.

values.name: Power Requirement
values._why: e.g. 'one standard 110v outlet'.

values.name: Setup Time Required
values._why: Stated so clients know setup happens outside billed time.

values.name: Indoor Outdoor Capability
values._why: One sentence on whether outdoor is supported and under what conditions.

values.name: What Is Included
values._why: Equipment, staff, setup/teardown. Answers 'what do I actually get'.

values.name: Staffing Included
values._why: Whether an attendant stays on site. Big differentiator.

values.name: Google Review Link
values._why: The review request workflow is inert without it.

values.name: Insurance Statement
values._why: Client's own wording only. The AI must never state coverage amounts - see the MUST-NOT-STATE guardrails.

values.name: Booking Lead Time Preferred
values._why: e.g. '3-4 weeks'. Used in nurture urgency messaging.

values.name: Peak Season Note
values._why: Which months fill first - drives the 'book early' urgency line.

values.name: Referral Offer
values._why: Leave blank if the client has no referral offer. NEVER invent one - the patio build shipped emails promising a discount that did not exist.

values.name: Repeat Customer Offer
values._why: Same rule. Blank means the copy omits the offer entirely.

values.name: Internal Notification Email
values._why: Where new-lead and escalation alerts go. Ships blank so no vendor address leaks into a client account.

_base_overlap._comment: Base (Skool) assets that overlap ours. Base workflows 1-8 reference the BASE names, so these are retired only as each workflow is rewritten to our names - never before. Deleting early = silent blank merge fields, the exact bug the patio base shipped.
